t: A lesson where pupils wear a micro:bit logger and graph their break time movement.
steps: Find the Tracking our physical activity lesson.
Drag the file onto each micro:bit V2.
Attach a battery pack and a wrist strap.
Practice starting and stopping the log with A and B.
Plug the board into a computer to read MY_DATA after break.
Copy the data first. Transferring a new hex file erases it.
